literal: Death escaping even will be achieved, through penance's power to those who have attained.
translation: Even escaping death is possible for those who have attained the power of penance.
modern: தவத்தின் வலிமையைப் பெற்றவர்களுக்கு, எமனைக் கடந்து உயிர் பிழைப்பதும் சாத்தியமாகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the supreme power of penance. The author states that those who have successfully attained the spiritual strength and power that comes from practicing penance can achieve anything, even overcoming or escaping death itself. The word 'கூற்றம்' refers to death, and 'குதித்தல்' means to leap over or escape. The phrase 'கைகூடும்' emphasizes that such an extraordinary feat becomes easily attainable for them. Thus, the couplet illustrates that the power of self-discipline and austerity transcends even the ultimate physical limitation of mortality.
